"""Complete metadata/static checks without rerunning model mechanics."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from importlib.metadata import version
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")
RESULT = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cpu-readout-mechanics.provenance.json"


def checksum(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def owned(command: list[str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    child = subprocess.Popen(
        command,
        cwd=ROOT,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        start_new_session=True,
    )
    timed_out = False
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=60)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
    finally:
        child.wait()
    return {
        "command": command,
        "cap_seconds": 60,
        "pid": child.pid,
        "exit_code": child.returncode,
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "reaped": True,
        "seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
        "stdout": stdout,
        "stderr": stderr,
    }


def main() -> None:
    if RESULT.exists():
        raise ValueError("Preserve previous provenance")
    receipt = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cpu-readout-mechanics.json"
    record = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(receipt.read_bytes()))
    descriptor = cast(dict[str, str], record["source_archive"])
    archive = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(Path(descriptor["path"]).read_bytes()))
    source_rows = cast(list[dict[str, str]], archive["files"])
    stable = all(checksum(Path(row["path"])) == row["sha256"] for row in source_rows)
    baseline = (
        ROOT / "benchmarks/real/engine-cpu-prefix-production-verification-final.json"
    )
    if (
        checksum(baseline)
        != "5aa107ec9736714138a28b45900bb93140eb663b69c8c12d81499a46c0f01b07"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Native baseline differs")
    baseline_record = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(baseline.read_bytes()))
    table = cast(dict[str, str], baseline_record["source_sha256"])
    production = {
        name: checksum(ROOT / name) for name in table if name.startswith("wyat/")
    }
    targets = [
        "benchmarks/analysis/torch/readout",
        "tests/analysis/test_cpu_readout_block.py",
    ]
    checks = {
        "ruff_lint": owned([str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"), "check", *targets]),
        "ruff_format": owned(
            [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"), "format", "--check", *targets]
        ),
        "mypy": owned(
            [
                str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/mypy"),
                "--strict",
                "--ignore-missing-imports",
                "--follow-imports=silent",
                *targets,
            ]
        ),
    }
    files = [Path(__file__), Path("/private/tmp/wyat-cpu-readout-check.py")]
    output = {
        "mechanics_receipt": {"path": str(receipt), "sha256": checksum(receipt)},
        "source_archive_verified": checksum(Path(descriptor["path"]))
        == descriptor["sha256"],
        "source_before_and_after_static_checks_unchanged": stable
        and all(checksum(Path(row["path"])) == row["sha256"] for row in source_rows),
        "runtime_metadata": {
            "python": sys.version,
            "executable": sys.executable,
            "packages": {
                name: version(name)
                for name in ("torch", "transformers", "pytest", "hypothesis", "numpy")
            },
        },
        "production_after_tiny_matches_native_baseline": len(production) == 22
        and all(value == table[name] for name, value in production.items()),
        "production_sha256": production,
        "checks": checks,
        "producer_sources": [
            {"path": str(path), "sha256": checksum(path), "text": path.read_text()}
            for path in files
        ],
        "limits": [
            "Production identity checked after tiny execution against immutable prior baseline",
            "Package versions do not attest every imported object or native binary",
            "No trained checkpoint or physical-memory/performance experiment ran",
        ],
    }
    with RESULT.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(output, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps({name: item["exit_code"] for name, item in checks.items()}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Own one bounded tiny mechanics child and immutable source/raw evidence."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")
RESULT = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cpu-readout-mechanics.json"
BASE = Path("/private/tmp/wyat-cpu-readout-mechanics-20261005")
SOURCES = [
    ROOT / name
    for name in (
        "benchmarks/analysis/torch/readout/__init__.py",
        "benchmarks/analysis/torch/readout/block.py",
        "tests/analysis/test_cpu_readout_block.py",
    )
] + [
    ROOT / ".venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages" / name
    for name in (
        "transformers/models/qwen3/modeling_qwen3.py",
        "transformers/cache_utils.py",
        "transformers/integrations/sdpa_attention.py",
        "transformers/masking_utils.py",
        "torch/nn/modules/module.py",
        "torch/nn/functional.py",
    )
]


def checksum(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> None:
    if RESULT.exists() or BASE.exists():
        raise ValueError("Preserve existing evidence")
    records = [
        {"path": str(path), "text": path.read_text(), "sha256": checksum(path)}
        for path in SOURCES
    ]
    payload = json.dumps({"files": records}, indent=2).encode()
    archive_sha = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    archive = RESULT.with_name(RESULT.stem + ".sources-" + archive_sha[:16] + ".json")
    with archive.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write(payload)
    command = [
        str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/pytest"),
        "-q",
        "-rs",
        "tests/analysis/test_cpu_readout_block.py",
        "--basetemp",
        str(BASE),
    ]
    started = time.perf_counter()
    child = subprocess.Popen(
        command,
        cwd=ROOT,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        start_new_session=True,
    )
    timed_out = False
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=60)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
    finally:
        child.wait()
    result = {
        "command": command,
        "cwd": str(ROOT),
        "pid": child.pid,
        "cap_seconds": 60,
        "seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
        "exit_code": child.returncode,
        "timed_out": timed_out,
        "reaped": True,
        "stdout": stdout,
        "stderr": stderr,
        "source_archive": {"path": str(archive), "sha256": archive_sha},
        "source_unchanged": all(
            checksum(Path(row["path"])) == row["sha256"] for row in records
        ),
        "raw_outputs": [
            {"path": str(path), "sha256": checksum(path), "text": path.read_text()}
            for path in sorted(BASE.rglob("*.json"))
        ],
        "limits": [
            "Synthetic tiny mechanics/head geometry, not learned-model quality or latency",
            "Actual CPU dispatch applies only to the two separately profiled calls",
        ],
    }
    with RESULT.open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(result, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {k: result[k] for k in ("exit_code", "seconds", "timed_out", "reaped")}
        )
    )
    print(stdout)
    print(stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
